verdict.rationale: SumUp's docs explicitly describe in-person acceptance of card payments via physical readers (chip/contactless via Solo/Go readers, Cloud API) and Tap to Pay for direct contactless acceptance on a compatible phone, covering chip, contactless, and mobile-wallet-capable in-person flows. Missing for 10: explicit named confirmation of Apple Pay/Google Pay wallet support specifically (only 'contactless' and 'mobile-wallet' terminals generically referenced) and independent/hands-on corroboration beyond vendor docs.
